draft.emotion: a practical and common sound, like the jingle of pocket change
notes: While this word is used for 'coin' (physical money), it is also used for 'medal' or a circular prize. In everyday life, you will most often use it for loose change when shopping.
Do not confuse this with 'ธนบัตร' (tá-ná-bàt), which refers specifically to paper banknotes.
